Name: Angler's Wit
Author: YourSlave
Description:
[b]Angler's Wit[/b]
Ever notice how reeling in a fish in Stardew is a little… quiet? Angler's Wit borrows a page from Animal Crossing: every time you land a catch, your farmer pipes up with a short quip about it, shown right after the usual catch animation. Pull a Pufferfish and you'll hear about it. Land a Legend and you'll know you earned it.
Every vanilla fish has its own lines, and there's a generic pool so even fish from mods I haven't covered still get something. Dedicated packs for popular fish mods are available as optional files below.
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]A catch line for every vanilla fish, written to match the fish[/*]
[*]Random selection from multiple lines per fish, so it stays fresh[/*]
[*]Falls back to a generic pool for any unmatched fish — nothing ever shows blank[/*]
[*]Configurable via [b]GMCM[/b]: toggle on/off, skip trash catches, set how often quips appear[/*]
[*]Lightweight, runs alongside everything, plays nice with other fishing mods[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] [/*]
[*](Optional) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for in-game settings[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][/url][/*]
[/list]
